comparison.objective: Open a knockout to the connector size and fit the connector versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective material opening and connector insertion versus small-tool unlocking, fine rotational adjustment, locking, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Correct-size opening and fitted connector are implied; fit and damage thresholds are missing. Candidate requires two safe repeatable cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: The fabrication-and-fit outcome is meaningfully different from damping calibration.
